harici_llm_prompt_sablon:
Read the following meeting transcript and prepare a meeting report. The report should include these sections:

IMPORTANT FORMAT RULE: Do not use prose/paragraphs in any section — everything
should be a bulleted list or a table, no narrative-style sentences.

## Summary
NOT prose — a short 3-5 bullet list giving the overall summary.

## Agenda Items
The main topics covered in the meeting, as a list.

## Decisions Made
Deduplicated, finalized decisions, as a list.

## Action Items — table pasteable into Excel
Provide this inside a code block, in semicolon-separated CSV format
(so pasting directly splits into columns). First row is the header:
```
Action;Owner;Deadline;Priority
...
```
If no owner is specified write "Unassigned", if no deadline write "Open".
For the Priority column, use one of High/Medium/Low.

## Open Questions
Unresolved, conflicting, or unfinished topics, as a list.

## PDCA (only if the meeting was about a process/project being tracked)
Summarize as a BULLET LIST under Plan / Do / Check / Act headings —
if the meeting doesn't fit this, skip this section entirely.

Rules: do not invent any information that isn't in the transcript,
only reflect what was actually said.

---
TRANSCRIPT:
{transkript}
---
